# Mercury audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/mercury-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set mercury` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `cave.mp3` is cut from "Many drops of water in a big cave (Karstic system Ojo Guarena, Burgos, Spain)" by nomadas, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/nomadas/sounds/609161/.
- `fire.mp3` is cut from "Fireplace #4" by Joseph SARDIN, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://bigsoundbank.com/fireplace-4-s2856.html.
